top4.why: The -23K payrolls print pushed Fed expectations dovish, tech moved back in step with SPY (correlation 0.33 to 0.81), and XLK rose 7.2% (SMH 7.8%) on the market's strongest 1-year trend. The AI chain tends to rally ahead of NVDA's Aug 26 report, but this is the high-beta pick that suffers most if Tuesday's core CPI is hot.

Gold's surge, the dollar index falling below 101 and a 55.6 ISM help it whether the market trades on rate cuts or on stronger growth. It gained 4.8% on the week, behind only tech, on a 23% 1-year trend led by NEM, FCX and ALB.

ISM manufacturing at 55.6, the highest since May 2022, with its employment index back in expansion and CAT's record Q2 point to rising cyclical earnings. As a middle-beta cyclical it should hold up better than growth if CPI comes in hot.

It is up 22% over the year, with LLY and AMGN strong and biotech catching a bid as the 10-year yield falls. It is my defensive pick for the CPI week, since utilities, staples and REITs are the defensive sectors actually losing ground.
